dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Have you changed any habits recently to protect the environment?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I try to reduce waste, so I stopped buying plastic bottles.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: That is a good start. Do you recycle everything at home?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Everything I can. Paper, glass, plastic and even food scraps for compost.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Impressive. I should do more, but it takes so much time.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It becomes automatic after a few weeks, honestly.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: What about transport? Cars produce a lot of emissions.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I cycle to work most days, and I use trains for long trips.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Do you think individual actions really matter, though?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: They do, but companies and governments must act on a bigger scale.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: I agree. Renewable energy is where the biggest change must happen.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Exactly. Solar and wind power are becoming cheaper every year.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Some people still say sustainable products are too expensive.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: In the short term, maybe, but they last longer and save money later.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: You have convinced me. I will start with a compost bin.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Small steps are better than waiting for a perfect solution.
